module.name: Live Observability Collector
module.description: Cloud-agnostic primitive: deploy a Fluent Bit DaemonSet that tails all pod logs in the cluster, parses JSON entries, promotes model/status/job as Loki stream labels, and forwards matching records to the Loki push API. Real live log collection — not a data generator. Only activates when enable_pod_log_collection=true.

required.reason: Namespace must exist before the Fluent Bit ServiceAccount and DaemonSet are created.
Loki must be deployed and its service name/port known before the collector is configured to push to it.

optional.name: observability_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where Fluent Bit runs. Auto-wired from live-observability-namespace.

optional.name: loki_service_name
optional.description: Loki Kubernetes Service name. Used to construct the in-cluster DNS hostname for the Fluent Bit Loki output (Host field). Auto-wired from live-observability-loki output loki_service_name.

optional.name: loki_port
optional.description: Loki HTTP API port. Used as the Port field in the Fluent Bit Loki output. Auto-wired from live-observability-loki output loki_port.

optional.name: enable_pod_log_collection
optional.description: When true, deploy the Fluent Bit DaemonSet. Set false to skip log collection (Loki will still receive pushes from producers that call the API directly).

optional.name: fluent_bit_version
optional.description: Fluent Bit container image tag. Default is a stable production release.

key_outputs.name: collector_installed
key_outputs.description: Whether the Fluent Bit DaemonSet was deployed (enable_pod_log_collection=true).

key_outputs.name: collector_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once the Fluent Bit DaemonSet has rolled out (or collection was disabled). Downstream readiness module depends on this.
